intro: Defend an interpretation with a precise reference and listen to an alternative reading.

texto: First state your reading; support it with a phrase or detail from the text: **Dette ser vi i avsnitt to, der…** («We see this in paragraph two, where…»). Then compare another reading with **En annen mulig tolkning er…** («Another possible interpretation is…»). A reference supports an interpretation, but it may not fully prove it.

frases.estudio: Da Lea kom tilbake til parken, var benken malt blå. Hun satte seg likevel på steintrappa. En avis lå igjen på setet. «Noen har husket hva jeg sa», tenkte hun. Hun brettet avisen sammen og la den i vesken.
frases.alumno: When Lea returned to the park, the bench had been painted blue. Even so, she sat down on the stone steps. A newspaper was left on the seat. "Someone remembered what I said," she thought. She folded the newspaper and put it in her bag.

frases.estudio: Jeg tror benken betyr noe for Lea. Hun kommer tilbake til parken.
frases.alumno: I think the bench means something to Lea. She goes back to the park.

frases.estudio: Det kan stemme, men teksten sier også at noen har husket ordene hennes.
frases.alumno: It might be true, but the text also says that someone remembered her words.

frases.estudio: Det er et godt poeng. Kanskje avisen viser at hun føler seg sett.
frases.alumno: That's a good point. Maybe the newspaper shows that she feels seen.

pregunta.texto: What detail supports the second interpretation?

opciones.texto: Lea thinks someone remembered her words
opciones.explicacion: That thought supports the interpretation that she feels valued.
The colour appears in the story, but it doesn't by itself support that reading.
The text doesn't say the park was empty.

pregunta.texto: Formulate an interpretation of the micro-text and support it with two details; add another possible reading.

textos: Lea ser ut til å føle seg lagt merke til fordi noen har husket det hun sa. Hun kommer tilbake til parken og tar vare på avisen. En annen tolkning er at hun bare vil unngå at avisen blir liggende.

piezas.explicacion: Open model: point out the clues and recognise that a second reading is also possible.
